decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several speakers across different price points and use cases. The JBL Charge 5 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_120) was selected because of its exceptional rating (4.8) and high review count, which provides confidence in its sound quality and durability. While the Harman Kardon Onyx Studio 6 was a strong competitor, the JBL's IP67 rating and built-in powerbank make it more versatile for outdoor adventures. The Audio Pro speakers were excluded due to their high price and specific focus on multi-room setups, while the cheaper options like HyperGear and NOTABRICK, though attractive, lacked the brand reliability and proven performance of the JBL.
